title: Error reporting surface: in-app error message with a "Tell us about it" report action
decision: Every failure surfaced to a player during a session or during adventure import shall be presented as a clear, human-readable error message in the application's own interface, accompanied by a "Tell us about it" action that lets the player submit a report about the failure from within the app. The error message and the report action are part of the application's own surface; no third-party crash-reporting or support-desk product is introduced, and the report action is the single, uniform failure surface across the app rather than per-feature ad hoc error handling.
rationale: The founder register records this class as decided: "A clear error message with a \"Tell us about it\" button." with the reason "This way we'll be notified of bugs and improve." This ADR implements that decision literally: the failure surface is an in-app message plus a report action, and the report action exists specifically so the team is notified of bugs and can improve the product. Because the decision names the user-visible behavior (a clear message and a report affordance) rather than a vendor, the architecture keeps the surface in-application and uniform, which also keeps the failure path consistent with the self-contained operation the SRS requires (R-10) - the error surface itself must not depend on an external service being reachable in order to tell the player what went wrong. A uniform surface also serves the requirements that already mandate informing the user on rejection paths (R-3, R-7, R-8), so those paths reuse one mechanism instead of each inventing its own.

options_considered.option: Embed a third-party crash-reporting and support-desk SDK as the failure surface
options_considered.reason: Rejected: it introduces an external service dependency for the failure path, which conflicts with the self-contained operation the SRS requires (R-10), and the founder decision specifies an in-app message plus a report action, not a vendor product.

options_considered.option: Per-feature bespoke error handling with no shared report action
options_considered.reason: Rejected: it would not satisfy the founder's stated purpose of being notified of bugs, since reports would be inconsistent or absent, and it duplicates failure handling across session, import, and override paths.

options_considered.option: Silent failure with logging only, no user-visible message
options_considered.reason: Rejected: the founder decision explicitly requires a clear error message the user sees, and several SRS acceptance criteria require the user to be informed when an action is rejected.
